**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Model pickers
- **Each provider's own pick is marked.** Under "More models" in Dictate and Meeting Transcription, the model we would choose for a provider carries "Best Gemini pick" or "Best OpenAI pick" when that provider has more than one model there.

## Read Aloud
- **Switches to a cloud voice once you add a key.** If Read Aloud fell back to the macOS voice because you had no key yet, adding one now moves it back (with a Gemini key: Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS). A macOS voice you picked yourself stays.

## Offline Dictate Prompt
- **No spoken "Doppelpunkt" in the result.** With Parakeet and a local model, spoken punctuation is now also applied to the model's reply, so the word no longer ends up in your note.
- **"Neue Zeile" makes a line break** even when Parakeet runs it into the next word.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.50...v8.51
